<script>
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
  if (e.target && /^(INPUT|TEXTAREA)$/.test(e.target.tagName)) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
    e.preventDefault();
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  }
}, true);
</script>
